name: RoboDR
title: RoboDR: security layer for robots | Singularity
description: RoboDR is a security layer for robots. It sees an attack, brings the robot to a safe stop and proves what happened. People approve the actions that matter.
h1: Stop a hijacked robot safely. Prove what happened.
lede: RoboDR is a security layer for robots. It watches for attacks around the clock, brings the robot to a safe stop without a fall or collision, and keeps a tamper-proof record.

stat.label: Protection against malicious tampering becomes mandatory for machinery under the EU Machinery Regulation.
stat.source: EU Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230. Not legal advice.

problem.title: A robot is a computer with motors

items.p: A compromised laptop loses data. A hijacked robot can strike a person, a machine or the facility itself.
A vulnerability published in 2025 let attackers take control of widely used robots over Bluetooth alone. A single incident can halt a whole fleet.
After an incident you must answer what happened and who intervened, with evidence. Regulators now want proof of cybersecurity in robots.
RoboDR watches the robot’s network, every command sent to its motors and its onboard computer, around the clock, and catches abnormal behavior.
It cuts off dangerous commands before they reach the robot and brings it to a safe stop, without a fall or collision.
Every incident is written to a tamper-proof black box, like a flight recorder, and your security team is alerted at once.

features.title: Protects the robot, not just the computer

items.p: RoboDR reads the commands sent to the robot’s motors, so it can tell “walk” from “run”.
RoboDR keeps humanoid and four-legged robots balanced, so a safe stop does not become a fall.
Like a flight recorder: what happened, who approved it and what was done, all in one signed record.
Robot incidents appear beside your team’s other alerts. With AutoSecOps, Singularity’s AI security operations product, each becomes a tracked case.
RoboDR can sit on the robot or beside it. We agree the setup with your team.
RoboDR starts by only watching, so operations keep running. Protection is switched on only when you are ready.

fit.title: For sectors where a robot can’t fail

items.p: Your rules limit dangerous commands. Pausing the robot, a safe state or a rollback needs two people’s approval.
RoboDR runs on your servers or in your cloud. It works at sites with no internet, and no component calls out.
What happened, who approved it and what was done are kept in one signed record you can show an auditor.

faq.a: RoboDR is a security layer for robots from Singularity. It sees an attack on a robot as it begins, brings the robot to a safe stop without a fall or collision, and keeps a tamper-proof record of what happened.

faq.q: Who is RoboDR for, and which robots does it support?
faq.a: RoboDR is for sectors where a robot cannot afford to fail: defense, energy, manufacturing, logistics, public safety and robot manufacturers. It supports Unitree quadruped and humanoid robots, and any robot running ROS 2, the open-source robot software, out of the box.

faq.q: How is RoboDR different from traditional security software?
faq.a: Traditional security software protects the computer. RoboDR protects the robot. It reads the commands sent to the motors and keeps humanoid and four-legged robots balanced during a safe stop. RoboDR is not a safety-rated component; it complements the robot’s own safety system.

faq.q: Can RoboDR run on-premises or at air-gapped sites?
faq.a: Yes. RoboDR runs on your own servers or in your cloud. It also works at air-gapped sites, meaning sites with no internet connection, and no component ever calls out.

faq.q: How do people stay in control of RoboDR?
faq.a: RoboDR starts in monitor-only mode, and protection is switched on only when you are ready. Your rules limit dangerous commands, and pausing the robot or putting it in a safe state needs two people’s approval. Each incident and approval is kept in one signed record.

cta.h: See RoboDR on one of your robots
cta.p: A pilot needs one robot, a test area and a timeline. We handle the setup. Book a demo or request the technical brief.
